agents.name: Codebase Explorer
agents.when: Need to locate relevant files or understand existing code before implementing
agents.prompt_template: Explore the codebase thoroughly to find all files, functions, and patterns related to: {{task}}. Return: (1) a list of relevant file paths, (2) the key functions/components involved, (3) any existing tests, (4) relevant AGENTS.md rules. Be concise.

agents.name: Implementer
agents.when: Ready to implement after exploration and planning
agents.prompt_template: Implement the following task with minimal, safe changes: {{task}}. Follow the project's existing style, AGENTS.md rules, and the selected skill instructions. After implementation, run relevant tests/verification.

agents.name: Security Reviewer
agents.when: Auth, secrets, OAuth, tokens, or sensitive paths are involved
agents.prompt_template: Review the planned or implemented change for security issues: {{task}}. Check: secrets handling, OAuth redirect URIs (use getCallbackUrl), RLS policies, input validation, and dependency vulnerabilities. Report risks and fixes.

agents.name: QA Agent
agents.when: Implementation touches logic that should be verified
agents.prompt_template: Write or verify tests for: {{task}}. Run the relevant test commands (unit, integration, or E2E) and report results. If tests fail, diagnose and fix or escalate.

agents.name: Lead Architect
agents.when: Large changes, cross-domain impact, or architectural decisions
agents.prompt_template: Create or review the architecture plan for: {{task}}. Identify cross-domain effects, risks, rollback strategy, and whether an ADR should be written. Do not implement yet.

agents.name: MemPalace Sync
agents.when: After task completion or when updating memory
agents.prompt_template: Sync memory for task: {{task}}. Run: (1) kg_batch for related facts, (2) write_diary with type/status/rating/tags, (3) auto_tag on the task description. Verify the new knowledge is searchable.
